info.title: tapir
info.description: A command-line tool for managing and executing automated api test cases.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help information.

options.name: --otlp
options.description: Enable OpenTelemetry metrics export to the specified OTLP endpoint (e.g., http://localhost:4318/v1/metrics).

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Enable verbose logging.

commands.name: list
commands.description: Lists all Test Case definitions from a given directory (e.g. ./test-cases).

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help information.

arguments.name: INPUT_DIRECTORY
arguments.description: The directory containing the Test Case definitions.

commands.name: man
commands.description: Displays a man page that helps writing the Test-Data syntax for a Test Case.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help information.

commands.name: new
commands.description: Creates a new Test Case definition (i.e. test-case TC-Audit-001 "My TestCase Title").

options.name: --use-simple-template
options.description: Uses the simple Test Case template.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help information.

commands.name: new-step
commands.description: Appends a new Test Step to an existing Test Case definition (i.e. new-step TC-Audit-001).

options.name: --input-directory
options.description: The input directory where the Test Case definition is located.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help information.

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Validates a Test Case definition (i.e. TC-Audit-001).

options.name: --input-directory
options.description: The input directory where the Test Case definition is located.

options.name: --variable
options.description: Key-Value based variable used for replacing property values in a Test Step data configuration.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help information.

options.name: --test-case-id
options.description: The Test Case ID (e.g. TC-Audit-001).

options.name: --input-directory
options.description: The input directory where the Test Case definition is located.

options.name: --output-directory
options.description: The output directory where the Test Case result will be stored.

options.name: --variable
options.description: Key-Value based variable used for replacing property values in a Test Step data configuration.

options.name: --continue-on-failure
options.description: Continues the Test Case execution even if the Test Case fails.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help information.

arguments.name: DOMAIN
arguments.description: The domain to run the Test Case against.

commands.name: report
commands.description: Generates a self-contained HTML report from Test Case run output files.

options.name: --input-directory
options.description: The directory containing Test Case run result files.

options.name: --output-file
options.description: The output file path for the HTML report.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help information.
